name: Hakuryuu
source:
The dragon's appearance after he gained back some of his power.
He hasn't recovered all of his power however, so he still can't return to his dragon form.
His appearance may be adult now, but his personality is still the same as before and it makes the protagonist feel a little awkward.
translation:
The dragon's appearance after he gained back some of his power.
He hasn't recovered all of his power however, so he still can't return to his dragon form.
His appearance may be adult now, but his personality is still the same as before and it makes the protagonist feel a little awkward.
